cc:Work.dc:description: Native vocabulary; 1,000 TCGA primary tumors; six measured masking ratios and three mask seeds. Error bars and baseline band show mask-seed SD, not patient CIs. Training mean uses BRIDGE targets. Gene panels differ between models. Undefined correlations are omitted. Animation progressively reveals saved curves, not additional estimates or evolving predictions.
